title: Are We Done with UMLS Injection into Language Models for Medical Question Answering?
abstract: arXiv:2610.33801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Maybe not. The Unified Medical Language System (UMLS) has become an oracle for millions of clinicians and health system developers worldwide. Researchers have increasingly used knowledge graphs derived from UMLS to enhance language models' factual accuracy and reasoning traceability in high-stakes tasks. Medical Question Answering (MQA) is a prime testbed for integration, with benchmarks usually involving professional exercises such as disease diagnosis and drug prescription from patient history. Despite the assumed benefits, empirical evidence shows that UMLS-based graph injection typically yields modest performance gains. This paper reviews existing MQA work, critically analyzing the selected UMLS sources and their usage with language models, and probes each of these choices in isolation. translated_title: 我们是否已经完成了将UMLS注入语言模型用于医学问答的研究？
translated_abstract: 也许还没有。统一医学语言系统（UMLS）已成为全球数百万临床医生和医疗系统开发者的权威资源。研究人员越来越多地使用从UMLS衍生的知识图谱来增强语言模型在高风险任务中的事实准确性和推理可追溯性。医学问答（MQA）是这种整合的主要测试平台，其基准测试通常涉及从患者病史进行疾病诊断和药物处方等专业练习。尽管人们假定这种整合有诸多好处，但实证证据表明，基于UMLS的图谱注入通常只能带来有限的性能提升。本文回顾了现有的MQA研究，批判性地分析了所选的UMLS来源及其与语言模型的结合使用方式，并逐一单独考察这些选择。我们发现了以往工作中从未被讨论过的方法学问题，从UMLS覆盖率低到子图检索流程薄弱等。基于我们的发现，我们……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文批判性回顾了将UMLS知识图谱注入语言模型用于医学问答的现有研究，揭示了从UMLS覆盖率低到子图检索流程薄弱等以往未被讨论过的方法学问题，表明UMLS注入的实际收益有限，该方向的研究远未完成。
en_tdlr: This paper critically reviews UMLS knowledge graph injection into language models for medical question answering, uncovering previously undiscussed methodological issues—from low UMLS coverage to weak subgraph retrieval pipelines—showing that the assumed benefits yield only modest gains and this research direction is far from done.
